title: Hide Photo Vault  &Videos
summary: Lock photos with a password, lock them for hiding, and protect private privacy.
description:
Do you want to protect the private photos/videos on your phone? Worried about the potential leak of private files if your phone gets lost, threatening your personal privacy? This is a secure vault for hiding personal pictures and videos, ensuring the safety of your privacy and photos.

Simply import your phone's pictures or videos into the Photo Vault, and view them securely within. Here, there's an advanced application password lock that provides high-level security for your privacy and photos.

🔒 Preserve beautiful memories
🔒 Store photos of family and friends
🔒 Private Browser
🔒 Protect copies of your ID, credit cards, and driver's license
🔒 Save important documents
🔒 PIN protect your photo vault

Protect your privacy and security by setting an app password, using an app lock, and regularly backing up photos to the vault. Keep your album confidential, and hand over your smartphone to friends and family without worry when you have the Photo Lock app installed on your phone.

Features Upgrade:
Restore deleted photos and videos
Accidentally deleted precious photos or videos? Don't worry, you can quickly recover them from the recycle bin. The gallery automatically stores deleted files in the recycle bin, making it easy for you to find all deleted photos and videos.

Password recovery
Worried about forgetting your password? Set up a secure email in the app, and you can quickly recover your forgotten password.

Features:
- Digital password protection: Provides reliable personal privacy protection, with security reaching 100%. Users can access their photo and video vault using a password.
- Intruder Capture: Automatically takes photos of unauthorized visitors to enhance security.
- Fake Password Space: Set a fake password to display a false interface for privacy protection.
- Theme Customization: Choose from a variety of themes, including pets, weather, calendar, and clock.
- Third-Party Cloud Sync: Easily sync your photos and videos.
- Emergency Switch Feature: Quickly close the app and launch another app with one tap.
- Multilingual Support: Supports multiple languages, providing a more convenient user experience.
- Batch management: Supports importing/exporting photos and videos at any time.
- Private Browser: Securely browse the web and easily save web images while protecting your privacy.
- Automatic sorting: Automatically sorts files by import date/creation date.
- Customization: Customize the cover and theme of the album according to personal preferences.
- Built-in camera: Photos taken can be saved directly within the app.
- WIFI transfer: Supports file transfer via WIFI.
- Trash recovery: Can recover accidentally deleted photos and videos.
- Video library: Provides a dedicated feature for protecting private videos.
- No storage limit: Can hide an unlimited number of photos and videos.

Hide Photo Vault & Videos is a secure and professional encrypted album software that helps you be prepared! Encrypt your private files with multiple layers of security, hide important photos in the encrypted album to prevent leaks of private photos. Easily hide and encrypt your photos and videos, giving your privacy true protection.
